      , customers_src_10000.country AS customer__country

      , subq_4.__revenue_eur AS revenue_eur

      -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'orders'
      -- Metric Time Dimension 'order_date'
      -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
      SELECT
        customer_id AS customer
        , status AS order__status
        , 1 AS __orders_total
        , amount AS __revenue_eur
      FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."orders" orders_src_10000

WITH ctr_1_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'leads'
  -- Metric Time Dimension 'created_date'
  -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', created_date) AS metric_time__day
    , lead_id AS lead
    , campaign_id AS campaign
    , 1 AS __leads
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."leads" leads_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', created_date) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)

, rss_10006_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'campaigns'
  SELECT
    channel
    , campaign_id AS campaign
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."campaigns" campaigns_src_10000
)

, sma_10004_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'bookings'
  -- Metric Time Dimension 'booked_date'
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', booked_date) AS metric_time__day
    , lead_id AS lead
    , campaign_id AS campaign
    , 1 AS __bookings
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."bookings" bookings_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_26.lead_to_booking_rate) AS lead_to_booking_rate
  , MAX(subq_35.leads) AS leads
  , MAX(subq_45.bookings) AS bookings
FROM (
  -- Combine Aggregated Outputs
  -- Compute Metrics via Expressions
  SELECT
    CAST(MAX(subq_24.__bookings) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(NULLIF(MAX(subq_9.__leads), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS lead_to_booking_rate
  FROM (
    -- Constrain Output with WHERE
    -- Select: ['__leads']
    -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
    SELECT
      SUM(leads) AS __leads
    FROM (
      -- Join Standard Outputs
      -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel']
      SELECT
        rss_10006_cte.channel AS campaign__channel
        , ctr_1_cte.__leads AS leads
      FROM ctr_1_cte
      LEFT OUTER JOIN
        rss_10006_cte
      ON
        ctr_1_cte.campaign = rss_10006_cte.campaign
    ) subq_6
    WHERE campaign__channel = 'search'
  ) subq_9
  CROSS JOIN (
    -- Find conversions for lead within the range of 30 day
    -- Select: ['__bookings']
    -- Select: ['__bookings']
    -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
    SELECT
      SUM(__bookings) AS __bookings
    FROM (
      -- Dedupe the fanout with mf_internal_uuid in the conversion data set
      SELECT DISTINCT
        FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.__leads) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            subq_19.lead
            , subq_19.metric_time__day
            , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
          ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS __leads
        , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.campaign__channel) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            subq_19.lead
            , subq_19.metric_time__day
            , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
          ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS campaign__channel
        , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.metric_time__day) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            subq_19.lead
            , subq_19.metric_time__day
            , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
          ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS metric_time__day
        , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.lead) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            subq_19.lead
            , subq_19.metric_time__day
            , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
          ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS lead
        , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.campaign) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            subq_19.lead
            , subq_19.metric_time__day
            , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
          ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS campaign
        , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid AS mf_internal_uuid
        , subq_19.__bookings AS __bookings
      FROM (
        -- Constrain Output with WHERE
        -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel', 'metric_time__day', 'lead', 'campaign']
        SELECT
          metric_time__day
          , lead
          , campaign
          , campaign__channel
          , leads AS __leads
        FROM (
          -- Join Standard Outputs
          -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel', 'metric_time__day', 'lead', 'campaign']
          SELECT
            ctr_1_cte.metric_time__day AS metric_time__day
            , ctr_1_cte.lead AS lead
            , ctr_1_cte.campaign AS campaign
            , rss_10006_cte.channel AS campaign__channel
            , ctr_1_cte.__leads AS leads
          FROM ctr_1_cte
          LEFT OUTER JOIN
            rss_10006_cte
          ON
            ctr_1_cte.campaign = rss_10006_cte.campaign
        ) subq_14
        WHERE campaign__channel = 'search'
      ) subq_16
      INNER JOIN (
        -- Read From CTE For node_id=sma_10004
        -- Add column with generated UUID
        SELECT
          metric_time__day
          , lead
          , __bookings
          , GEN_RANDOM_UUID() AS mf_internal_uuid
        FROM sma_10004_cte
      ) subq_19
      ON
        (
          subq_16.lead = subq_19.lead
        ) AND (
          (
            subq_16.metric_time__day <= subq_19.metric_time__day
          ) AND (
            subq_16.metric_time__day > subq_19.metric_time__day - MAKE_INTERVAL(days => 30)
          )
        )
    ) subq_20
  ) subq_24
) subq_26

  -- Select: ['__leads']
  -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
  -- Compute Metrics via Expressions

  FROM (
    -- Join Standard Outputs
    -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel']
    SELECT

      , ctr_1_cte.__leads AS leads
    FROM ctr_1_cte
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
      rss_10006_cte
    ON

    -- Select: ['__bookings']

  -- Select: ['__bookings']

          subq_19.lead
          , subq_19.metric_time__day

        ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC

-- Combine Aggregated Outputs
-- Compute Metrics via Expressions
-- Order By [] Limit 200
-- Write to DataTable
WITH ctr_1_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'leads'
  -- Metric Time Dimension 'created_date'
  -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', created_date) AS metric_time__day
    , lead_id AS lead
    , campaign_id AS campaign
    , 1 AS __leads
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."leads" leads_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', created_date) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)

, rss_10006_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'campaigns'
  SELECT
    channel
    , campaign_id AS campaign
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."campaigns" campaigns_src_10000
)

SELECT
  CAST(MAX(subq_24.__bookings) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(NULLIF(MAX(subq_9.__leads), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS lead_to_booking_rate
FROM (
  -- Constrain Output with WHERE
  -- Select: ['__leads']
  -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
  SELECT
    SUM(leads) AS __leads
  FROM (
    -- Join Standard Outputs
    -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel']
    SELECT
      rss_10006_cte.channel AS campaign__channel
      , ctr_1_cte.__leads AS leads
    FROM ctr_1_cte
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
      rss_10006_cte
    ON
      ctr_1_cte.campaign = rss_10006_cte.campaign
  ) subq_6
  WHERE campaign__channel = 'search'
) subq_9
CROSS JOIN (
  -- Find conversions for lead within the range of 30 day
  -- Select: ['__bookings']
  -- Select: ['__bookings']
  -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
  SELECT
    SUM(__bookings) AS __bookings
  FROM (
    -- Dedupe the fanout with mf_internal_uuid in the conversion data set
    SELECT DISTINCT
      FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.__leads) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_19.lead
          , subq_19.metric_time__day
          , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS __leads
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.campaign__channel) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_19.lead
          , subq_19.metric_time__day
          , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS campaign__channel
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.metric_time__day) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_19.lead
          , subq_19.metric_time__day
          , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS metric_time__day
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.lead) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_19.lead
          , subq_19.metric_time__day
          , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS lead
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.campaign) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_19.lead
          , subq_19.metric_time__day
          , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS campaign
      , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid AS mf_internal_uuid
      , subq_19.__bookings AS __bookings
    FROM (
      -- Constrain Output with WHERE
      -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel', 'metric_time__day', 'lead', 'campaign']
      SELECT
        metric_time__day
        , lead
        , campaign
        , campaign__channel
        , leads AS __leads
      FROM (
        -- Join Standard Outputs
        -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel', 'metric_time__day', 'lead', 'campaign']
        SELECT
          ctr_1_cte.metric_time__day AS metric_time__day
          , ctr_1_cte.lead AS lead
          , ctr_1_cte.campaign AS campaign
          , rss_10006_cte.channel AS campaign__channel
          , ctr_1_cte.__leads AS leads
        FROM ctr_1_cte
        LEFT OUTER JOIN
          rss_10006_cte
        ON
          ctr_1_cte.campaign = rss_10006_cte.campaign
      ) subq_14
      WHERE campaign__channel = 'search'
    ) subq_16
    INNER JOIN (
      -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'bookings'
      -- Metric Time Dimension 'booked_date'
      -- Add column with generated UUID
      SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', booked_date) AS metric_time__day
        , lead_id AS lead
        , 1 AS __bookings
        , GEN_RANDOM_UUID() AS mf_internal_uuid
      FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."bookings" bookings_src_10000
    ) subq_19
    ON
      (
        subq_16.lead = subq_19.lead
      ) AND (
        (
          subq_16.metric_time__day <= subq_19.metric_time__day
        ) AND (
          subq_16.metric_time__day > subq_19.metric_time__day - MAKE_INTERVAL(days => 30)
        )
      )
  ) subq_20
) subq_24
LIMIT 200

-- Order By [] Limit 200
-- Write to DataTable
SELECT
  metric_time__month
  , customers_to_date
FROM (
  -- Window Function for Metric Re-aggregation
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , LAST_VALUE(customers_to_date) OVER (
      PARTITION BY metric_time__month
      ORDER BY metric_time__day
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS customers_to_date
  FROM (
    -- Constrain Output with WHERE
    -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
    -- Select: ['__signups', 'metric_time__month', 'metric_time__day']
    -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
    -- Compute Metrics via Expressions
    -- Compute Metrics via Expressions
    SELECT
      metric_time__day
      , metric_time__month
      , SUM(signups) AS customers_to_date
    FROM (
      -- Join Self Over Time Range
      -- Select: ['__signups', 'customer__country', 'metric_time__month', 'metric_time__day']
      SELECT
        subq_6.metric_time__day AS metric_time__day
        , subq_6.metric_time__month AS metric_time__month
        , subq_5.customer__country AS customer__country
        , subq_5.__signups AS signups
      FROM (
        -- Read From Time Spine '"time_spine"'
        SELECT
          date_day AS metric_time__day

FROM orders_subset o

    SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_ts
    FROM silver.orders
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'
),
ordered AS (

           LAG(order_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts) AS prev_ts
    FROM sep_orders
),

    SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_ts - prev_ts)) / 3600.0 AS gap_hours
    FROM ordered
    WHERE prev_ts IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gap_hours) AS median_gap_hours
FROM gaps;

FROM range_orders;

WITH sept_orders AS (
  SELECT customer_id, order_ts
  FROM silver.orders
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
),
qualified_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM sept_orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT so.customer_id,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (so.order_ts - LAG(so.order_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY so.customer_id ORDER BY so.order_ts)))/3600.0 AS gap_hours
  FROM sept_orders so
  JOIN qualified_customers qc USING (customer_id)
)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gap_hours) AS median_gap_hours,
       COUNT(*) AS gap_count
FROM gaps
WHERE gap_hours IS NOT NULL;

WITH sept_orders AS (
    SELECT customer_id, order_ts
    FROM silver.orders
    WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+00'
      AND order_ts <  TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00'
),
gapped AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        order_ts,
        LAG(order_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts) AS prev_ts
    FROM sept_orders
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_ts - prev_ts)) / 3600.0 AS gap_hours
    FROM gapped
    WHERE prev_ts IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gap_hours) AS median_gap_hours
FROM gaps;

  from silver.orders
  where order_date between date '2026-08-17' and date '2026-10-02'

-- Combine Aggregated Outputs
-- Compute Metrics via Expressions
-- Order By [] Limit 200
-- Write to DataTable
WITH ctr_0_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'leads'
  -- Metric Time Dimension 'created_date'
  -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', created_date) AS metric_time__day
    , lead_id AS lead
    , campaign_id AS campaign
    , 1 AS __leads
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."leads" leads_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', created_date) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)

, rss_10006_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'campaigns'
  SELECT
    channel
    , campaign_id AS campaign
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."campaigns" campaigns_src_10000
)

SELECT
  CAST(MAX(subq_25.__bookings) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(NULLIF(MAX(subq_10.__leads), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS lead_to_booking_rate
FROM (
  -- Constrain Output with WHERE
  -- Select: ['__leads']
  -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
  SELECT
    SUM(leads) AS __leads
  FROM (
    -- Join Standard Outputs
    -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel']
    SELECT
      rss_10006_cte.channel AS campaign__channel
      , ctr_0_cte.__leads AS leads
    FROM ctr_0_cte
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
      rss_10006_cte
    ON
      ctr_0_cte.campaign = rss_10006_cte.campaign
  ) subq_7
  WHERE campaign__channel = 'search'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  -- Find conversions for lead within the range of 30 day
  -- Select: ['__bookings']
  -- Select: ['__bookings']
  -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
  SELECT
    SUM(__bookings) AS __bookings
  FROM (
    -- Dedupe the fanout with mf_internal_uuid in the conversion data set
    SELECT DISTINCT
      FIRST_VALUE(subq_17.__leads) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_20.lead
          , subq_20.metric_time__day
          , subq_20.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_17.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS __leads
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_17.campaign__channel) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_20.lead
          , subq_20.metric_time__day
          , subq_20.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_17.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS campaign__channel
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_17.metric_time__day) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_20.lead
          , subq_20.metric_time__day
          , subq_20.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_17.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS metric_time__day
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_17.lead) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_20.lead
          , subq_20.metric_time__day
          , subq_20.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_17.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS lead
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_17.campaign) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_20.lead
          , subq_20.metric_time__day
          , subq_20.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_17.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS campaign
      , subq_20.mf_internal_uuid AS mf_internal_uuid
      , subq_20.__bookings AS __bookings
    FROM (
      -- Constrain Output with WHERE
      -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel', 'metric_time__day', 'lead', 'campaign']
      SELECT
        metric_time__day
        , lead
        , campaign
        , campaign__channel
        , leads AS __leads
      FROM (
        -- Join Standard Outputs
        -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel', 'metric_time__day', 'lead', 'campaign']
        SELECT
          ctr_0_cte.metric_time__day AS metric_time__day
          , ctr_0_cte.lead AS lead
          , ctr_0_cte.campaign AS campaign
          , rss_10006_cte.channel AS campaign__channel
          , ctr_0_cte.__leads AS leads
        FROM ctr_0_cte
        LEFT OUTER JOIN
          rss_10006_cte
        ON
          ctr_0_cte.campaign = rss_10006_cte.campaign
      ) subq_15
      WHERE campaign__channel = 'search'
    ) subq_17
    INNER JOIN (
      -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'bookings'
      -- Metric Time Dimension 'booked_date'
      -- Add column with generated UUID
      SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', booked_date) AS metric_time__day
        , lead_id AS lead
        , 1 AS __bookings
        , GEN_RANDOM_UUID() AS mf_internal_uuid
      FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."bookings" bookings_src_10000
    ) subq_20
    ON
      (
        subq_17.lead = subq_20.lead
      ) AND (
        (
          subq_17.metric_time__day <= subq_20.metric_time__day
        ) AND (
          subq_17.metric_time__day > subq_20.metric_time__day - MAKE_INTERVAL(days => 30)
        )
      )
  ) subq_21
) subq_25
LIMIT 200

-- Select: ['__candidates_in_stage']
-- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT candidates_in_stage) AS candidates_in_stage
FROM (
  -- Join Standard Outputs
  -- Select: ['__candidates_in_stage', 'candidate__stage', 'candidate__applied_date__day']
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', applications_src_10000.applied_date) AS candidate__applied_date__day
    , candidate_stages_src_10000.stage AS candidate__stage
    , subq_3.__candidates_in_stage AS candidates_in_stage
  FROM (
    -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'candidate_days'
    -- Metric Time Dimension 'calendar_date'
    -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-10-04T00:00:00, 2026-10-04T00:00:00]
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('day', calendar_date) AS metric_time__day
      , candidate_id AS candidate
      , candidate_id AS __candidates_in_stage
    FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."candidate_days" candidate_days_src_10000
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', calendar_date) BETWEEN '2026-10-04' AND '2026-10-04'
  ) subq_3
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    "dbt_dev"."silver"."applications" applications_src_10000
  ON
    subq_3.candidate = applications_src_10000.candidate_id
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    "dbt_dev"."silver"."candidate_stages" candidate_stages_src_10000
  ON
    (
      subq_3.candidate = candidate_stages_src_10000.candidate_id
    ) AND (
      (
        subq_3.metric_time__day >= candidate_stages_src_10000.valid_from_date
      ) AND (
        (
          subq_3.metric_time__day < candidate_stages_src_10000.valid_to_date
        ) OR (
          candidate_stages_src_10000.valid_to_date IS NULL
        )
      )
    )
) subq_10
WHERE (
  candidate__applied_date__day between '2026-09-25' and '2026-10-02'
) AND (
  candidate__stage in ('applied', 'screen', 'interview', 'offer')
)

WITH first_orders AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date
  FROM silver.orders
  WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
wo AS (
  SELECT o.amount, o.order_date, f.first_order_date
  FROM silver.orders o
  JOIN first_orders f ON f.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND o.currency = 'EUR'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN order_date = first_order_date THEN amount END)::numeric, 2) AS first_time_avg_eur,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN order_date > first_order_date THEN amount END)::numeric, 2) AS returning_avg_eur,
  ROUND(
    AVG(CASE WHEN order_date > first_order_date THEN amount END)
    - AVG(CASE WHEN order_date = first_order_date THEN amount END)
  ::numeric, 2) AS euros_less
FROM wo;

-- Combine Aggregated Outputs
-- Compute Metrics via Expressions
-- Order By [] Limit 200
-- Write to DataTable
WITH ctr_0_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'leads'
  -- Metric Time Dimension 'created_date'
  -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', created_date) AS metric_time__day
    , lead_id AS lead
    , campaign_id AS campaign
    , 1 AS __leads
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."leads" leads_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', created_date) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)

, rss_10006_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'campaigns'
  SELECT
    channel
    , campaign_id AS campaign
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."campaigns" campaigns_src_10000
)

SELECT
  CAST(MAX(subq_24.__bookings) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(NULLIF(MAX(subq_9.__leads), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS lead_to_booking_rate
FROM (
  -- Constrain Output with WHERE
  -- Select: ['__leads']
  -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
  SELECT
    SUM(leads) AS __leads
  FROM (
    -- Join Standard Outputs
    -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel']
    SELECT
      rss_10006_cte.channel AS campaign__channel
      , ctr_0_cte.__leads AS leads
    FROM ctr_0_cte
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
      rss_10006_cte
    ON
      ctr_0_cte.campaign = rss_10006_cte.campaign
  ) subq_6
  WHERE campaign__channel = 'search'
) subq_9
CROSS JOIN (
  -- Find conversions for lead within the range of 30 day
  -- Select: ['__bookings']
  -- Select: ['__bookings']
  -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
  SELECT
    SUM(__bookings) AS __bookings
  FROM (
    -- Dedupe the fanout with mf_internal_uuid in the conversion data set
    SELECT DISTINCT
      FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.__leads) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_19.lead
          , subq_19.metric_time__day
          , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS __leads
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.campaign__channel) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_19.lead
          , subq_19.metric_time__day
          , subq_19.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_16.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS campaign__channel
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_16.metric_time__day) OVER (
        PARTITION BY

WITH sept_signups AS (
  SELECT customer_id, signup_date
  FROM silver.customers
  WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND signup_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'
),
ordered_early AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
  FROM sept_signups s
  JOIN silver.orders o ON o.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= s.signup_date AND o.order_date <= s.signup_date + INTERVAL '30 days'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sept_signups) AS total_signups,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ordered_early) AS ordered_within_30d,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ordered_early) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sept_signups), 0), 2) AS share_percent;

WITH repeat_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM silver.orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
period_orders AS (
    SELECT order_date, customer_id, amount
    FROM silver.orders
    WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
)
SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM repeat_customers) THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customer_revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM repeat_customers) THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(amount),0), 2) AS repeat_share_percent
FROM period_orders;

WITH leads_cte AS (
  SELECT lead_id
  FROM silver.leads
  WHERE created_date IN (DATE '2026-10-01', DATE '2026-10-02')
),
booked_leads AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lead_id
  FROM silver.bookings
  WHERE lead_id IN (SELECT lead_id FROM leads_cte)
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_leads,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.lead_id) AS booked_leads,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT b.lead_id) / COUNT(*), 2) END AS conversion_share_percent
FROM leads_cte l
LEFT JOIN booked_leads b ON l.lead_id = b.lead_id;

WITH filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.amount, c.signup_date
    FROM silver.orders o
    JOIN silver.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN 'pre_2026'
            WHEN signup_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND signup_date < DATE '2027-01-01' THEN 'in_2026'
            ELSE 'other'
        END AS cohort,
        amount
    FROM filtered_orders
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cohort='pre_2026' THEN amount END)::numeric, 2) AS avg_pre_2026_eur,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cohort='in_2026' THEN amount END)::numeric, 2) AS avg_in_2026_eur,
    ROUND((AVG(CASE WHEN cohort='pre_2026' THEN amount END) - AVG(CASE WHEN cohort='in_2026' THEN amount END))::numeric, 2) AS difference_eur
FROM grouped
WHERE cohort IN ('pre_2026','in_2026');

WITH sep_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, signup_date
    FROM silver.customers
    WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND signup_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'
),
orders_within_30 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
    FROM sep_customers c
    JOIN silver.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN c.signup_date AND c.signup_date + INTERVAL '30 days'
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_sep_customers,
    COUNT(o.customer_id) AS customers_with_order_30d,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(o.customer_id) / COUNT(*), 2) AS share_percent
FROM sep_customers c
LEFT JOIN orders_within_30 o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id;

WITH valid_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, amount
  FROM silver.orders
  WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
    AND currency = 'EUR'
),
period_orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM valid_orders
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
),
repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM valid_orders
  WHERE order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
)
SELECT 
  SUM(po.amount) AS total_period_revenue_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN po.amount ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customer_revenue_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rc.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN po.amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(po.amount),0), 2) AS repeat_share_percent
FROM period_orders po
LEFT JOIN repeat_customers rc USING (customer_id);

WITH paired AS (
  SELECT m.sent_ts, r.replied_ts,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.replied_ts - m.sent_ts))/3600.0 AS hours_diff
  FROM silver.outreach_messages m
  JOIN silver.outreach_replies r ON r.message_id = m.message_id
  WHERE m.sent_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND m.sent_date <= DATE '2026-10-03'
),
direct AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (first_replied_ts - sent_ts))/3600.0 AS hours_diff
  FROM silver.outreach_messages
  WHERE sent_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND sent_date <= DATE '2026-10-03'
    AND first_replied_ts IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY hours_diff) FROM paired) AS median_hours_join,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paired) AS n_join,
  (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY hours_diff) FROM direct) AS median_hours_direct,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM direct) AS n_direct;

  JOIN silver.outreach_replies r ON r.message_id = m.message_id
  WHERE m.sent_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND m.sent_date <= DATE '2026-10-03'

FROM diffs;

WITH rev AS (
  SELECT order_date AS dt, revenue_eur
  FROM gold.daily_sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03'
),
sess AS (
  SELECT activity_date AS dt, site_sessions
  FROM gold.customer_engagement_daily
  WHERE activity_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03'
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(r.revenue_eur),0) AS total_revenue_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.site_sessions),0) AS total_site_sessions,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.site_sessions),0) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE COALESCE(SUM(r.revenue_eur),0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(s.site_sessions),0)
  END AS revenue_per_site_session_eur
FROM rev r
FULL OUTER JOIN sess s ON r.dt = s.dt;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.message_id) AS total_messages,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.message_id) FILTER (WHERE r.first_reply_ts IS NOT NULL AND r.first_reply_ts - m.sent_ts <= interval '12 hours') AS replied_within_12h,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT m.message_id) FILTER (WHERE r.first_reply_ts IS NOT NULL AND r.first_reply_ts - m.sent_ts <= interval '12 hours') / COUNT(DISTINCT m.message_id), 2) AS share_percent
FROM silver.outreach_messages m
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT message_id, MIN(replied_ts) AS first_reply_ts
  FROM silver.outreach_replies
  GROUP BY message_id
) r ON r.message_id = m.message_id
WHERE m.sent_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-03';

WITH first_orders AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date
  FROM silver.orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date, o.amount,
         fo.first_order_date,
         CASE WHEN o.order_date = fo.first_order_date THEN 'first-time' ELSE 'returning' END AS buyer_type
  FROM silver.orders o
  JOIN first_orders fo ON o.customer_id = fo.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
    AND o.currency = 'EUR'
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN buyer_type = 'first-time' THEN amount END),2) AS avg_first_time,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN buyer_type = 'returning' THEN amount END),2) AS avg_returning,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN buyer_type = 'returning' THEN amount END) - AVG(CASE WHEN buyer_type = 'first-time' THEN amount END),2) AS diff_euros
FROM filtered;

FROM search_leads sl

WITH orders_filtered AS (
    SELECT order_id, amount
    FROM silver.orders
    WHERE order_date IN (DATE '2026-10-01', DATE '2026-10-02')
),
refunds_filtered AS (
    SELECT r.order_id, r.amount
    FROM silver.returns r
    JOIN orders_filtered o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS total_refund_amount,
    CASE WHEN SUM(o.amount) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(SUM(r.amount),0) / SUM(o.amount) END AS refund_rate_by_value
FROM orders_filtered o
LEFT JOIN refunds_filtered r ON o.order_id = r.order_id;

  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date, o.amount

),
classified AS (
  SELECT ro.amount,
         CASE WHEN ro.order_date = cf.first_order_date THEN 'first_time' ELSE 'returning' END AS buyer_type
  FROM range_orders ro
  JOIN customer_first cf ON ro.customer_id = cf.customer_id
)
SELECT 
  round(avg(CASE WHEN buyer_type='returning' THEN amount END) - avg(CASE WHEN buyer_type='first_time' THEN amount END), 2) AS euros_less
FROM classified;

  SELECT customer_id, min(order_date) AS first_order_date
  FROM silver.orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
range_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date, o.amount
  FROM silver.orders o
  JOIN customer_first cf ON o.customer_id = cf.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT ro.amount,
         CASE WHEN ro.order_date = cf.first_order_date THEN 'first_time' ELSE 'returning' END AS buyer_type
  FROM range_orders ro
  JOIN customer_first cf ON ro.customer_id = cf.customer_id
)
SELECT 
  round(avg(CASE WHEN buyer_type='returning' THEN amount END) - avg(CASE WHEN buyer_type='first_time' THEN amount END), 2) AS euros_less
FROM classified;

WITH ctr_0_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'leads'
  -- Metric Time Dimension 'created_date'
  -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-09-01T00:00:00, 2026-09-30T00:00:00]
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', created_date) AS metric_time__day
    , lead_id AS lead
    , campaign_id AS campaign
    , 1 AS __leads
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."leads" leads_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', created_date) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)

, rss_10006_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'campaigns'
  SELECT
    channel
    , campaign_id AS campaign
  FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."campaigns" campaigns_src_10000
)

SELECT
  CAST(MAX(subq_25.__bookings) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(NULLIF(MAX(subq_10.__leads), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS lead_to_booking_rate
FROM (
  -- Constrain Output with WHERE
  -- Select: ['__leads']
  -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
  SELECT
    SUM(leads) AS __leads
  FROM (
    -- Join Standard Outputs
    -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel']
    SELECT
      rss_10006_cte.channel AS campaign__channel
      , ctr_0_cte.__leads AS leads
    FROM ctr_0_cte
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
      rss_10006_cte
    ON
      ctr_0_cte.campaign = rss_10006_cte.campaign
  ) subq_7
  WHERE campaign__channel = 'search'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  -- Find conversions for lead within the range of 30 day
  -- Select: ['__bookings']
  -- Select: ['__bookings']
  -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
  SELECT
    SUM(__bookings) AS __bookings
  FROM (
    -- Dedupe the fanout with mf_internal_uuid in the conversion data set
    SELECT DISTINCT
      FIRST_VALUE(subq_17.__leads) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_20.lead
          , subq_20.metric_time__day
          , subq_20.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_17.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS __leads
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_17.campaign__channel) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_20.lead
          , subq_20.metric_time__day
          , subq_20.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_17.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS campaign__channel
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_17.metric_time__day) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_20.lead
          , subq_20.metric_time__day
          , subq_20.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_17.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS metric_time__day
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_17.lead) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_20.lead
          , subq_20.metric_time__day
          , subq_20.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_17.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS lead
      , FIRST_VALUE(subq_17.campaign) OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          subq_20.lead
          , subq_20.metric_time__day
          , subq_20.mf_internal_uuid
        ORDER BY subq_17.metric_time__day DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS campaign
      , subq_20.mf_internal_uuid AS mf_internal_uuid
      , subq_20.__bookings AS __bookings
    FROM (
      -- Constrain Output with WHERE
      -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel', 'metric_time__day', 'lead', 'campaign']
      SELECT
        metric_time__day
        , lead
        , campaign
        , campaign__channel
        , leads AS __leads
      FROM (
        -- Join Standard Outputs
        -- Select: ['__leads', 'campaign__channel', 'metric_time__day', 'lead', 'campaign']
        SELECT
          ctr_0_cte.metric_time__day AS metric_time__day
          , ctr_0_cte.lead AS lead
          , ctr_0_cte.campaign AS campaign
          , rss_10006_cte.channel AS campaign__channel
          , ctr_0_cte.__leads AS leads
        FROM ctr_0_cte
        LEFT OUTER JOIN
          rss_10006_cte
        ON
          ctr_0_cte.campaign = rss_10006_cte.campaign
      ) subq_15
      WHERE campaign__channel = 'search'
    ) subq_17
    INNER JOIN (
      -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'bookings'
      -- Metric Time Dimension 'booked_date'
      -- Add column with generated UUID
      SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', booked_date) AS metric_time__day
        , lead_id AS lead
        , 1 AS __bookings
        , GEN_RANDOM_UUID() AS mf_internal_uuid
      FROM "dbt_dev"."silver"."bookings" bookings_src_10000
    ) subq_20
    ON
      (
        subq_17.lead = subq_20.lead
      ) AND (
        (
          subq_17.metric_time__day <= subq_20.metric_time__day
        ) AND (
          subq_17.metric_time__day > subq_20.metric_time__day - MAKE_INTERVAL(days => 30)
        )
      )
  ) subq_21
) subq_25
LIMIT 200

  SELECT
    COALESCE(subq_13.customer__country, subq_22.customer__country) AS customer__country
    , MAX(subq_13.orders_cancelled) AS orders_cancelled

        subq_4.order__status AS order__status

WITH cart_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session_id, event_date AS cart_date
  FROM silver.customer_actions
  WHERE channel = 'site'
    AND action_type = 'add_to_cart'
    AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03'
),
has_checkout AS (
  SELECT cs.session_id, cs.cart_date,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ca.action_type = 'checkout'
                  AND ca.channel = 'site'
                  AND ca.event_date IN (cs.cart_date, cs.cart_date + 1)
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checked_out
  FROM cart_sessions cs
  LEFT JOIN silver.customer_actions ca
    ON ca.session_id = cs.session_id
   AND ca.channel = 'site'
   AND ca.action_type = 'checkout'
  GROUP BY cs.session_id, cs.cart_date
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS cart_sessions,
  SUM(checked_out) AS checked_out_sessions,
  ROUND((1 - SUM(checked_out)::numeric / COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) AS cart_abandonment_rate_percent
FROM has_checkout;

WITH cart_sessions AS (
  SELECT session_id, min(event_date) AS cart_date
  FROM silver.customer_actions
  WHERE action_type = 'add_to_cart'
    AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-03'
  GROUP BY session_id
),
status AS (
  SELECT c.session_id, c.cart_date,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM silver.customer_actions ca
           WHERE ca.session_id = c.session_id
             AND ca.action_type = 'checkout'
             AND ca.event_date >= c.cart_date
             AND ca.event_date <= c.cart_date + INTERVAL '1 day'
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS checked_out
  FROM cart_sessions c
)
SELECT 
  count(*) AS cart_sessions,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE checked_out = 0) AS abandoned_sessions,
  ROUND(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE checked_out = 0)::numeric / count(*), 2) AS cart_abandonment_rate_percent
FROM status;
